title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for type 2 diabetes.

HPI
The patient presents for routine follow-up regarding their type 2 diabetes mellitus. They report generally feeling well with no acute complaints since the last visit. They continue taking their prescribed oral hypoglycemic agent, metformin, as directed. They state they are managing their diet and activity as advised. They report no symptoms related to their diabetes management. Examination today revealed no complications.

Medication List
Metformin

Exam
Vitals stable. Cardiovascular exam is unremarkable. Abdomen is soft and non-tender. Skin exam shows no signs of breakdown.

Assessment
1. Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: Patient is stable and has had no complications.
2. Medication management for type 2 diabetes mellitus.

Plan
Continue current oral hypoglycemic regimen with metformin. Follow up as scheduled. Encourage continued adherence to self-management plan for type 2 diabetes mellitus.
explanations: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
